CToken.initialize: sets comptroller, interest rate model, metadata and reentrancy flag.
CToken.transferTokens: internal cToken transfer with allowance and balance math.
CToken.transfer: external EIP-20 transfer guarded by nonReentrant.
CToken.transferFrom: external transfer on behalf of src, guarded by nonReentrant.
CToken.approve: sets transfer allowance for msg.sender.
CToken.balanceOfUnderlying: accrues interest and converts token balance to underlying.
CToken.getAccountSnapshot: returns token balance, borrow balance and exchange rate.
CToken.accrueInterest: computes interest from block delta and writes borrowIndex/totalBorrows/totalReserves.
CToken.mintInternal: accrues interest then calls mintFresh.
CToken.mintFresh: mint policy hook, external transfer in, mint token computation and state writes.
CToken.redeemInternal: accrues interest then calls redeemFresh with token amount.
CToken.redeemFresh: redeem policy hook, balance math, external transfer out, state writes.
CToken.borrowInternal: accrues interest then calls borrowFresh.
CToken.borrowFresh: borrow policy hook, external transfer out before writing accountBorrows and totalBorrows.
CToken.repayBorrowFresh: repays borrow, external transfer in, updates balances.
CToken.liquidateBorrowFresh: repays borrow, computes seize tokens and seizes collateral.
CToken.seize: external entry using msg.sender as the seizing cToken.
CToken.seizeInternal: moves collateral tokens from borrower to liquidator with math checks.
CToken._setPendingAdmin: admin-only pending admin update.
CToken._acceptAdmin: pending admin accepts and becomes admin.
CToken._setComptroller: admin-only comptroller replacement with marker check.
CToken._setReserveFactorFresh: admin-only reserve factor update with bounds check.
CToken._addReservesFresh: transfers tokens in and increases totalReserves.
CToken._reduceReservesFresh: admin-only reserve reduction transferring to admin.
CToken._setInterestRateModelFresh: admin-only interest rate model replacement.
nonReentrant modifier toggling the _notEntered guard around external interactions.
Comptroller.enterMarkets: adds markets to msg.sender assets list.
Comptroller.exitMarket: removes a market after liquidity and borrow checks.
Comptroller.addToMarketInternal: validates and registers account market membership.
Comptroller.mintAllowed: pause check, listing check, COMP distribution hook.
Comptroller.redeemAllowed: liquidity check plus COMP distribution.
Comptroller.redeemAllowedInternal: hypothetical liquidity check for redeemer.
Comptroller.borrowAllowed: pause, listing, oracle price and liquidity checks.
Comptroller.repayBorrowAllowed: listing check and COMP borrow distribution.
Comptroller.liquidateBorrowAllowed: shortfall and close factor validation.
Comptroller.seizeAllowed: pause, listing and comptroller match checks.
Comptroller.transferAllowed: pause check, redeem liquidity check and COMP distribution.
Comptroller liquidity engine iterating account assets and oracle prices.
Comptroller.liquidateCalculateSeizeTokens: derive collateral tokens to seize from oracle prices.
Comptroller._setPriceOracle: admin-only oracle replacement.
Comptroller._setCloseFactor: admin-only bounded close factor update.
Comptroller._setCollateralFactor: admin-only per-market collateral factor update.
Comptroller._setMaxAssets: admin-only max assets update.
Comptroller._setLiquidationIncentive: admin-only bounded incentive update.
Comptroller._supportMarket: admin-only market listing.
Comptroller._setPauseGuardian: admin-only guardian update.
Comptroller._setMintPaused: guardian/admin pause toggle with unpause restriction.
Comptroller._setBorrowPaused: guardian/admin pause toggle with unpause restriction.
Comptroller._setTransferPaused: guardian/admin global transfer pause toggle.
Comptroller._setSeizePaused: guardian/admin global seize pause toggle.
Comptroller._become: accepts unitroller implementation role after authorization.
Comptroller.adminOrInitializing: authorization check against admin or implementation.
Comptroller.refreshCompSpeeds: requires msg.sender == tx.origin then refreshes speeds.
Comptroller.refreshCompSpeedsInternal: recomputes per-market COMP speeds using utilities.
Comptroller.updateCompSupplyIndex: block-based accrual of the supply index.
Comptroller.updateCompBorrowIndex: block-based accrual of the borrow index.
Comptroller.distributeSupplierComp: computes supplier COMP delta and transfers.
Comptroller.distributeBorrowerComp: computes borrower COMP delta and transfers.
Comptroller.transferComp: external COMP token transfer above a threshold.
Comptroller.claimComp: distributes accrued COMP for holders across markets.
Comptroller._setCompRate: admin-only COMP rate update followed by speed refresh.
Comptroller._addCompMarkets: admin-only enabling of COMP markets.
Comptroller._dropCompMarket: admin-only disabling of a COMP market.
Comptroller.getBlockNumber: returns block.number for accrual calculations.
Unitroller fallback function delegating all calls to the comptroller implementation.
Unitroller._setPendingImplementation: admin-only pending brain update.
Unitroller._acceptImplementation: pending implementation becomes active brain.
Unitroller._setPendingAdmin: admin-only pending admin update.
Unitroller._acceptAdmin: pending admin becomes admin.
Comp.approve: uint96-capped allowance update for msg.sender.
Comp.transferFrom: allowance decrement and token movement.
Comp.delegateBySig: EIP-712 signature verification via ecrecover, nonce and expiry checks.
Comp._delegate: sets delegator delegate and moves votes.
Comp._transferTokens: moves balances and updates delegates.
Comp._moveDelegates: adjusts vote checkpoints for src and dst representatives.
Comp._writeCheckpoint: writes or updates a vote checkpoint using block.number.
CarefulMath.addUInt: addition returning INTEGER_OVERFLOW error instead of reverting.
CarefulMath.subUInt: subtraction returning INTEGER_UNDERFLOW error instead of reverting.
CarefulMath.mulUInt: multiplication returning INTEGER_OVERFLOW error.
CarefulMath.divUInt: division returning DIVISION_BY_ZERO error.
delegatecall(msg.data) in the Unitroller fallback to comptrollerImplementation.
External COMP token transfer call to an arbitrary token address.
External underlying transfer-in (ERC20/ETH) invoked after policy hooks.
External underlying transfer-out (ERC20/ETH) invoked before final state writes.
ecrecover used for delegateBySig signature recovery.
Assembly returndatacopy/return/revert in the Unitroller fallback forwarding raw returndata.
mintAmount: underlying amount supplied during mint.
redeemTokens: cToken amount redeemed by the user.
borrowAmount: underlying amount borrowed by the user.
repayAmount: underlying amount repaid or liquidated.
seizeTokens: collateral cToken amount transferred to the liquidator.
newPendingAdmin: address proposed as the next admin.
newReserveFactorMantissa: reserve factor value to set.
newInterestRateModel: interest rate model contract to install.
cToken: market address passed to policy hooks and admin setters.
borrower: account whose debt or collateral is affected.
liquidator: account repaying a borrow and receiving collateral.
dst: destination address of a token transfer.
src: source address of a token transfer.
account: account queried for balance, snapshot or liquidity.
cTokens: list of market addresses to enter or claim from.
newOracle: price oracle contract to install.
newCloseFactorMantissa: close factor value to validate and set.
newCollateralFactorMantissa: per-market collateral factor to set.
newMaxAssets: new maximum number of enterable markets.
state: boolean pause state for guardian pause setters.
delegatee: address receiving delegated votes.
expiry: timestamp after which a delegation signature is invalid.
holder: account whose accrued COMP is claimed.
compRate_: new COMP distribution rate per block.
addAmount: amount added to protocol reserves.
reduceAmount: amount removed from protocol reserves.
cTokenCollateral: collateral market seized during liquidation.
allowed: return code from a comptroller policy hook.
error: error code returned by accrueInterest before continuing an operation.
mathErr: MathError accumulator carried inside local var structs.
mintTokens: computed number of cTokens to mint.
redeemAmount: computed underlying amount paid on redeem.
accountBorrowsNew: updated borrower debt balance.
totalBorrowsNew: updated aggregate borrow balance.
actualRepayAmount: amount actually transferred in during repayment.
seizeTokens: computed collateral tokens seized in liquidation.
currentBlockNumber: block number cached in accrueInterest.
blockDelta: blocks elapsed since last accrual, used for interest math.
oldPendingAdmin: previous pending admin stored for the event.
oldComptroller: previous comptroller stored for the event.
shortfall: account shortfall returned by the liquidity engine.
exchangeRateMantissa: exchange rate read from the cToken during liquidity calc.
totalReservesNew: updated reserves balance.
signatory: address recovered from a delegation signature.
chainId: chain identifier read via assembly for EIP-712 domain.

edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against admin or comptrollerImplementation to authorize privileged operations.
refreshCompSpeeds requires msg.sender == tx.origin, delegating authorization to transaction origin.
msg.sender is passed as the payer into repayBorrowFresh.
seize uses msg.sender as the seizerToken instead of a parameter.
borrowAmount flows from the public entry point into borrowFresh which interacts with external token transfers.
borrowFresh calls doTransferOut (external transfer) before writing accountBorrows and totalBorrows.
redeemFresh calls doTransferOut before writing totalSupply and accountTokens, a reentrancy-relevant ordering.
mintFresh performs an external token transfer in via doTransferIn before updating supply state.
nonReentrant modifier guards borrowFresh using the _notEntered flag.
nonReentrant modifier guards redeemFresh against re-entrant calls.
nonReentrant modifier guards the mint path around the external transfer in.
liquidateBorrowFresh performs a repayment transfer in before seizing collateral from another market.
liquidateBorrowFresh invokes seizeInternal or an external seize on the collateral cToken.
Unitroller fallback delegatecalls an attacker-influenceable implementation address with raw msg.data.
comptrollerImplementation determines the delegatecall target, so its update must be strictly admin-gated.
delegateBySig derives the signatory through ecrecover, so signature malleability and nonce handling matter.
block.timestamp (now) is compared against expiry to authorize the delegation signature.
delegateBySig delegates votes for the recovered signatory.
transferComp performs an external COMP token transfer to a user-supplied address.
Comp.transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender for allowance deduction.
_notEntered is read and written by the nonReentrant modifier, forming the reentrancy guard state.
addUInt computes totalSupplyNew and accountTokensNew in mintFresh with overflow detection.
subUInt computes totalSupplyNew and accountTokensNew in redeemFresh with underflow detection.
addUInt computes accountBorrowsNew and totalBorrowsNew in borrowFresh.
subUInt computes the reduced borrow balances in repayBorrowFresh.
subUInt/addUInt adjust borrower and liquidator token balances in seizeInternal.
mulUInt scales borrow rate by block delta and principal by borrow index in interest accrual.
divUInt is used when converting accumulator values into final interest amounts.
closeFactorMantissa is multiplied with borrowBalance to cap the allowed repay amount.
liquidationIncentiveMantissa participates in the seize token arithmetic.
CToken._setPendingAdmin requires msg.sender == admin.
CToken._acceptAdmin requires msg.sender == pendingAdmin.
_setPauseGuardian requires msg.sender == admin.
_setMintPaused requires msg.sender to be the pauseGuardian or admin.
_setCompRate gates on adminOrInitializing derived from msg.sender.
_dropCompMarket requires msg.sender == admin.
_supportMarket requires msg.sender == admin.
_become requires msg.sender to equal unitroller.admin().
Unitroller._setPendingImplementation requires msg.sender == admin.
Unitroller._acceptImplementation requires msg.sender == pendingComptrollerImplementation.
Unitroller._setPendingAdmin requires msg.sender == admin.
Unitroller._acceptAdmin requires msg.sender == pendingAdmin.
updateCompSupplyIndex relies on block-number derived time delta for reward accrual, a miner-influenceable timing dependency.
comptroller.transferAllowed/transferVerify are invoked by transferTokens.
oracle.getUnderlyingPrice is consulted for the borrow price check.
oracle prices for both markets feed the seize token calculation.
totalBorrows is read and written during interest accrual.
totalReserves is read and written during interest accrual.
borrowIndex is updated with the new accumulator value in accrueInterest.
accrualBlockNumber is read for the block delta and rewritten after accrual.
totalSupply is read and updated by mintFresh.
accountTokens balances are read and written by transferTokens.
transferAllowances are consumed by transferTokens.
accountBorrows principal and interestIndex are written by borrowFresh after the transfer out.
markets mapping is read and mutated when an account joins a market.
accountAssets is iterated to compute hypothetical liquidity.
compSpeeds determines the supply speed used for index accrual.
compAccrued per supplier is updated in distributeSupplierComp.
compSupplyState stores the updated supply index and block number.
compBorrowState stores the updated borrow index and block number.
allowances are decremented inside Comp.transferFrom.
balances are updated inside Comp._transferTokens.
numCheckpoints is incremented in Comp._writeCheckpoint.
maxAssets is read in addToMarketInternal when validating new market entries.
allMarkets is iterated to recompute COMP speeds.
compSupplyIndex per market is read in distributeSupplierComp.
mintInternal delegates to mintFresh after accrual.
redeemInternal delegates to redeemFresh.
borrowInternal delegates to borrowFresh.
mintInternal calls accrueInterest before minting.
borrowInternal calls accrueInterest before borrowing.
redeemFresh calls the comptroller redeemAllowed hook.
borrowFresh calls the comptroller borrowAllowed hook.
mintFresh calls the comptroller mintAllowed hook.
repayBorrowFresh calls the comptroller repayBorrowAllowed hook.
liquidateBorrowFresh calls the comptroller liquidateBorrowAllowed hook.
seizeInternal calls the comptroller seizeAllowed hook.
transferTokens calls the comptroller transferAllowed hook.
seize delegates to seizeInternal with msg.sender as the seizer.
transfer routes through transferTokens.
transferFrom routes through transferTokens.
refreshCompSpeeds calls refreshCompSpeedsInternal.
refreshCompSpeedsInternal updates supply indices for all markets.
refreshCompSpeedsInternal updates borrow indices for all markets.
mintAllowed updates the COMP supply index.
mintAllowed distributes supplier COMP.
borrowAllowed performs a hypothetical liquidity check.
redeemAllowedInternal performs a hypothetical liquidity check.
exitMarket reuses redeemAllowedInternal for the full-balance check.
_become triggers _acceptImplementation on the unitroller.
distributeSupplierComp calls transferComp.
distributeBorrowerComp calls transferComp.
_delegate moves votes via _moveDelegates.
_transferTokens moves votes via _moveDelegates.
_moveDelegates writes vote checkpoints.
claimComp distributes supplier COMP for holders.
claimComp distributes borrower COMP for holders.
_setCompRate refreshes COMP speeds after updating the rate.
_addCompMarkets refreshes COMP speeds after enabling markets.
liquidateBorrowFresh calls liquidateCalculateSeizeTokens on the comptroller.
liquidateCalculateSeizeTokens performs external oracle calls for both markets.
the liquidity engine calls cToken.getAccountSnapshot externally per asset.
_addReservesFresh calls doTransferIn and can be re-entered by a malicious token.
_reduceReservesFresh calls doTransferOut after updating reserves.
accrueInterest queries interestRateModel.getBorrowRate for the current rate.
enterMarkets adds each market through addToMarketInternal.
accrueInterest reads the current block number.
updateCompSupplyIndex reads the current block number for the delta.
updateCompBorrowIndex reads the current block number for the delta.
borrowAllowed can auto-enter the borrower into the market.
liquidateBorrowFresh repays the borrower debt through repayBorrowFresh.
the fallback uses assembly to copy and forward raw returndata or revert.
mintFresh makes an external call into the comptroller mintAllowed hook, a cross-contract callback.
redeemFresh makes an external call into the comptroller redeemAllowed hook.
borrowFresh makes an external call into the comptroller borrowAllowed hook.
repayBorrowFresh makes an external call into the comptroller repayBorrowAllowed hook.
liquidateBorrowFresh makes an external call into the comptroller liquidateBorrowAllowed hook.
seizeInternal makes an external call into the comptroller seizeAllowed hook.
transferTokens makes an external call into the comptroller transferAllowed hook.

normalization_plan.reason: mintAmount is only meaningful as the input to the mint path and is consumed by mintFresh.
redeemTokens is the redeem amount consumed by redeemFresh.
borrowAmount is consumed by borrowFresh and its external transfer.
repayAmount is the repayment input consumed by repayBorrowFresh.
seizeTokens drives the balance math inside seizeInternal.
newPendingAdmin is only used by the pending admin setter.
the reserve factor parameter is validated and stored in _setReserveFactorFresh.
the model address is installed by _setInterestRateModelFresh.
the cToken market argument is consumed by policy hooks such as seizeAllowed.
borrower identifies the debt being liquidated inside liquidateBorrowFresh.
liquidator is the recipient of seized collateral in liquidateBorrowFresh.
dst is the transfer destination consumed by transferTokens.
src is the transfer source consumed by transferTokens.
account selects the asset list evaluated by the liquidity engine.
the cTokens array is iterated by enterMarkets to join markets.
newOracle is installed by the admin oracle setter.
the close factor input is bounded and stored by _setCloseFactor.
the collateral factor input is validated by _setCollateralFactor.
newMaxAssets is stored by the max assets setter.
the pause boolean is stored in the guardian pause setters.
delegatee is the vote recipient applied by _delegate.
expiry is compared against the current timestamp inside delegateBySig.
holder selects the account whose accrued COMP is distributed.
the new rate is stored and used for the speed refresh by _setCompRate.
addAmount is transferred in and added to reserves by _addReservesFresh.
reduceAmount is validated and transferred out by _reduceReservesFresh.
the collateral market is seized through liquidateBorrowFresh.
the hook return code is checked in mintFresh before continuing.
the accrual error code is handled by mintInternal before proceeding.
mathErr accumulates CarefulMath results throughout the mint flow.
mintTokens is computed and stored by mintFresh.
redeemAmount is the underlying amount paid out by redeemFresh.
the new borrower debt is written to storage by borrowFresh.
the new aggregate borrow value is written by borrowFresh.
the transferred-in amount determined by repayBorrowFresh.
the seize amount is produced and used by liquidateBorrowFresh.
the cached block number drives interest math in accrueInterest.
blockDelta scales the borrow rate inside accrueInterest.
the previous pending admin is only used for the event in the setter.
the previous comptroller is captured only for the event in _setComptroller.
shortfall is computed and returned by the liquidity engine.
the exchange rate is read per asset inside the liquidity engine.
the new reserve total is computed and stored by _reduceReservesFresh.
the recovered signatory authorizes the delegation inside delegateBySig.
the chain id is part of the EIP-712 domain used by delegateBySig.
